nodes.prompt: Establish the exact goal outcome, acceptance criteria and finite implementation/test allocation with the user. Emit the reviewed design and a workspace allocation keyed by test_design and implement, with exact qualified task identities and finite owned/consumed paths. An allocation does not authorize edits. For child goals use an explicitly reviewed graph binding matching immediate-parent grants; never infer authority from ancestry.

Independently review the exact design, acceptance criteria and finite allocation. Submit authorization only when all required findings are resolved; bind the exact manifest Ref, task identities and current policy hash. Emit an explicit approved or changes_requested decision and the review report. A rejected review is evidence, never downstream approval. Supply both output slots: changes_requested requires authorization null; approved requires exact workspace authorization. Null never grants authority.

Present the exact current design, allocation and independent review to the user. Submit only after explicit approval of that exact subject; preserve unresolved obligations. Bind authorization to the exact manifest, task identities and current policy.

Determine independent outcome boundaries from the approved design. Retain an atomic disposition when checkpoints do not independently satisfy the outcome. Do not invent optional work or change approved scope.

Reject incomplete or disconnected evidence; do not resolve findings without the required current subject and review. Emit an explicit approved or changes_requested decision and the review report. A rejected review is evidence, never downstream approval.
